## @cyberskill/design@1.7.2

- **Five-Domain Audit Closure:** Resolved all audit defects across tokens/native projections, components/types/a11y, templates/DOCX/print/email, docs/Storybook/public site, and CI/packaging/gate board.
- **Lifecycle & Support Governance:** Reviewed and stamped all 123 component and constant support records in `components/lifecycle.json` with SHA-256 evidence verification.
- **Custom Form Picker Accessibility (`R2-02`):** Added `"aria-labelledby"` support to `Combobox`, `DatePicker`, `TimePicker`, `ColorPicker`, `Cascader`, and `TreeSelect` across both trigger controls and open popup surfaces.
- **Linux Visual Baselines:** Synchronized all 15 PNG visual baselines in `_audit/baselines/` with deterministic Linux Chromium rendering.
- **3-Browser CI Acceleration:** Memoized canvas color parsing and parallelized Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit execution in `test-paper-text-contrast-browser.mjs` (~6x speedup) and across 31 multi-engine browser test scripts via `_audit/ci/lib/run-browsers.mjs`.
- **Dependabot Grouping:** Configured grouped weekly updates in `.github/dependabot.yml`.

verificationScope: Observed remote tag and registry metadata; no independent cryptographic provenance verification.
